category_selection: Exactly20 names from alphabetically sorted official45 with numpy default_rng(20261014).choice without replacement, then sorted; fixed before download/images/model scores. No validation or test category screening.
preprocessing: Full RGB256 original -> bicubic150 cache; fixed RGB/RG/B/mean optical encoding unchanged. No crop/segmentation/learned features.
split_policy: Exact original/cache pixel connected groups together; preserve all selected photos. Per class80/10/rest groups, no test inference or category reselection. Not a geographic-independent split.
limitations: Predeclared20-name subset, not all45; image-level exact-pixel groups do not establish location/scene independent generalization. No performance-guided category selection or optical test inference.
